profile_scope: All selected postprocessing source ancestry in one EP3 diagnostic DB; native-task identity retained server-side.
greedy_branch: MEASURED_AT_65_NATIVE_ARGMAX_CALLS_FROM_LINE1599; does not establish every request/iteration or exclude other branches globally

direct_dense_model.meaning: Logical uncompressed BF16 table size and current direct-dense MAC counts only. Not compulsory HBM traffic, an unconditional work lower bound, hardware throughput or a claimed gain.

source_answers: Per-step current code mutates logits[:,idx] with BF16 bias, selects argmax, optionally maps token space and copies the next ID into a stable buffer.

Each next Markov embedding consumes the preceding selected token. Direct evaluation cannot batch unknown future inputs without additional lookahead/precomputation; this is not a lower bound over all algorithms.
Probability path calls _sample_draft_from_logits and retains draft_probs; selected65 argmax records establish the greedy else branch for those calls.

Dynamic DSpark confidence update consumes last_hidden_states and draft_token_ids, not the full summed logits argument. Actual dynamic_spec value remains unverified; initializer activates it when dynamic_spec_config.method == dspark.
DSpark initializer explicitly sets use_cuda_graph=False. This applies to draft execution, not target graph replay.
Early return depends on num_speculative_tokens==1 or parallel_drafting; actual resolved parallel_drafting/vocab-map flags are not attested by source alone.

variants.graph: Read the current strided logits slice and bias, preserve BF16 add rounding and optional writeback, reduce with existing argmax semantics, produce INT64 IDs and keep token remap/copy order.
variants.supports: 65 Add+ArgMax+Cast records plus195 Slice/143 ViewCopy records; source binds each logical step.
constraints: same logits writeback and any external aliases
row padding/mask and stable buffer generation
per-step token recurrence and existing stream/event dependencies
variants.open: Historical stride/storage ownership and native Slice/ViewCopy semantics are not attested. A shape reporting the full base allocation does not prove all bytes are physically copied. Score-write deletion requires stronger all-consumer proof.

variants.graph: Keep base-head and compatible Markov work in matching vocabulary partitions through greedy selection; preserve global tie/index semantics and publish the same selected IDs.
constraints: same bias and add numerical boundary
token-space mapping and selected ID publication
probability/entropy/logprobs paths need their full distribution contract
other model/head consumers and graph lifetime
variants.open: This does not prove an AllGather can be removed. No per-rank ownership/complete consumer or end-to-end benefit is established.

variants.graph: Reuse an exactly computed Markov bias row for a repeated Markov input ID under frozen embedding/projection parameters; partial cache and full precomputation are distinct domains.
constraints: matching GEMM reduction/rounding and inference numeric mode
cache invalidation/capacity/lookup overhead and device ownership
variants.open: Actual repeated-ID frequency and memory headroom are absent. A full dense BF16 table is33426636800 logical bytes before indices/replication; this is not a feasible-capacity or speedup claim.
